**Boss:** [Chill Clawbster](#loc=75363)

Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75345: Clear [Special Portal 1](#loc=75273) in Prankster's Paradise as Sora.
75351: Automatically received after defeating the Nightmares that spawn when chasing Pinocchio.
75363:
**Weaknesses:** Thunder, Fire

Chill Clawbster will alternate between using body slams in the lower part of the arena, and firing projectiles from up on the higher ledges. These attacks look very impressive, but are very avoidable. You can either use ranged attacks for when Chill Clawbster is up on the ledges, or wait until it hops down to get some combos with your Keyblade.

After part of its health is gone, Chill Clawbster will flee and the arena will change. Riding atop a trapped Monstro, Sora must steer to avoid Chill Clawbster's laser attacks. Do this until Monstro is close enough, and he'll eat Chill Clawbster, ending the fight.
